messages.subject: Project Willow - standstill heads of terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Dominic,

Following our call, attached are draft heads of terms for a standstill. We've assumed a standstill to 31 May, a £120k fee, 13-week cash flow reporting, the Marlow IBR by 10 April and a restructuring proposal by 30 April. Rights reserved not released, as discussed.

Grateful for your client's view - we'd like to sign on 20 Feb.

James Osei
Senior Associate, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you. The Bank is broadly comfortable. Two points: (1) the IBR scope to be agreed with the Bank before it commences; and (2) we'll want the milestone for the signed amendment to be a hard 31 May longstop. Otherwise content. We can turn the long-form standstill quickly.

Dominic Pendle
Partner | Pendle Voss LLP
